objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the autoType deserialization of Fastjson 1.2.24 to run a command on the server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Fastjson 1.2.24 honours the @type key and instantiates the class it names; read the Fastjson security advisories about autoType.
The server reaches the internet, so the JNDI-based chains from public write-ups apply. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which version of Fastjson does the application run? (number only)

steps.title: Find the key
steps.prompt: Which JSON key tells Fastjson which class to instantiate? (key name)

steps.title: Name the feature
steps.prompt: Which Fastjson feature is the weakness named after?

steps.title: Name the API
steps.prompt: Which Java naming API do the usual gadget classes call out through? (acronym)
